systems.system: dispositif digital national de gestion (assurance maladie universelle)
systems.owner: Organisme de gestion de l'AMU (INAM transitionally, art. 108)

note: The universal health insurance law states nothing about an HMIS or an EMR: its one mention of the dossier médical (art. 36) gives the insurer's medical and pharmacist advisers a right of access to a beneficiary's medical file, without saying what form the file takes; art. 4 allows enrolment and care of the insured through a national digital management system to be set up progressively, an insurance administration system outside the study's classes.
